rounds.text: Raghunath International Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.40x [E2] and a P/E ratio of 5.21 [E1]. This valuation is starkly disconnected from the broader sector, where the company trades at a P/E of 4.83x against a benchmark of 18.84x [E6] and a P/B of 0.3x compared to a benchmark of 1.83x [E7]. Operational efficiency remains a core strength, as the company maintains an ROA of 5.26%, outperforming the sector benchmark of 3.52% [E8]. While long-term sales growth has been inconsistent, the company has demonstrated a massive recent turnaround with trailing twelve-month sales growth of 204% [E16]. Furthermore, the company has shown a strong capacity for long-term profit generation with a 10-year compounded profit growth rate of 23% [E17]. Conceded: the company has seen a 5-year compounded sales growth of -11% [E14], a 5-year compounded profit growth of -2% [E18], and a trailing twelve-month profit decline of -57% [E20].
